# Last Actor task run's default request queue

The API endpoints described in this section are convenience endpoints that provide access to Actor task's last run's default request queue without the need to resolve the request queue ID first.

Subset of functionality described in: [Request queues](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/storage-request-queues.md)

<!-- -->

## [Get last task run's default request queue](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-task-runs-last-request-queue-get.md)

[/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}/runs/last/request-queue](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-task-runs-last-request-queue-get.md)
